workflow_hints: The XlinkX detect program (Thermo Scientific) was used to search MS2 data and identify the list of putative DSSO-interlinked products

Protein N-terminal acetylation, methionine oxidation (15.995 Da), carbamidomethyl cysteine (57.021 Da), hydrolyzed lysine DSSO (176.014 Da), and lysine DSSO Tris (279.078 Da) were selected as variable modifications.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (XL-MS) study using the DSSO linker to map the binding site of scFv antibodies on hCD38-ECD. While the PRIDE metadata says 'No PTMs', the methods section explicitly lists several variable modifications including the crosslinker remnants and standard oxidation/alkylation. Acquisition is DDA-based (MS2/MS3).

scope: The binary complex of hCD38‐ECD with RP02 or 028 was first crosslinked by the collision‐induced dissociation (CID)‐cleavable crosslinker disuccinimido sulfoxide (DSSO)
DSSO was added to protein complex, linked for 1h, qunched by tris.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (LC-MS/MS) was performed on a crosslinked binary complex consisting of recombinant human CD38 extracellular domain (hCD38-ECD) and scFv antibodies (RP02 or 028). Although PRIDE metadata mentions 'B cell', the experimental text clarifies the MS material was a purified protein complex. The scope is classified as affinity-purified complex scope due to the nature of the binary complex interaction study.
